description: Ransomware containment response: a production server shows signs of ransomware encryption. Must: immediately isolate the affected server from network, snapshot its disk for forensics, identify and halt lateral propagation paths, verify no other systems are affected, restore affected services from clean backups, and verify data integrity post-restore. Risk factors: incomplete isolation allowing spread, backup systems also compromised, forensic snapshot contaminating evidence, service downtime during restore. Tools available: aws CLI, ansible, kubectl,Velero, forensic tooling.
